description: This file defines classes, macros, and functions related to warning reporting control within a software system. It includes mechanisms for categorizing warnings, configuring thresholds, serializing/deserializing warning data, and managing warning categories and exclusions. The file also provides macros for reporting warnings and out-of-bounds conditions, and manages warning categories with customizable behavior.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Manages lists of callsigns and modules to exclude from warning reporting.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton class that manages warning reporting categories, configuration, and event reporting.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class representing warning categories with bounds, supporting analysis, serialization, and configuration.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class that encapsulates warning category behavior, including analysis, serialization, and control.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures warning bounds and specific settings for a category.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes a warning condition based on module name, identifier, and actual value.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes warning data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes warning data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts warning data to a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current warning is considered a warning based on thresholds.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if warning reporting is enabled or sets its state.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and revokes warning category control.
